Django News documentation
=========================

Django News is a news website built with Django. It brings together
articles from news publications and from independent journalists, and
every article is approved before readers can see it.

These pages are built from the docstrings in the project's code, one
page for each of the project's apps.

   :maxdepth: 2
   :caption: Apps:

   accounts
   news
   api
   third_party
